searchQueries.query: Bristol City Council cadastral parcel boundaries land registry INSPIRE index polygons official
searchQueries.scope: Identify Bristol-specific public land parcel/registry mapping and distinguish legal parcel extents from title-index polygons.
searchQueries.result: HM Land Registry publishes INSPIRE Index Polygons as a freehold registered-property index with a download file per local authority, including Bristol. Its documentation cautions the file is not a legal boundary dataset; polygons on LA borders may occur in both files. Bristol City Council’s public INSPIRE map service lists thematic layers, including council asset land ownership, but no general cadastral parcel fabric.
